entities.label: Uzbekistan environmental atlas (source metadata)
entities.description: Facts taken verbatim from the source packages: titles, file sizes, formats, package membership.

entities.label: Portal curator
entities.description: A human reviewer who promotes, corrects or rejects proposals. Curator decisions are the training labels for the next model.

entities.label: Geospatial extraction pipeline
entities.description: Measured facts produced by the conversion scripts: geometry type, feature counts, bounding boxes, field names, derivation lineage.

entities.label: Character n-gram similarity model v1
entities.description: TF-IDF character n-gram model over bilingual titles and field names. Proposes observed properties, analysis concepts and related datasets with calibrated confidence. Replaceable by a satellite-embedding or language-model backend without changing the graph contract.

entities.label: Lexical seeding rules v1
entities.description: Deterministic term matching over English and Russian titles. Produces the weak-supervision seed for semantic predicates; never publishes as asserted on its own above the review threshold.
